fields.name: PERR
fields.text: Writing 1 clears the Pipe Error interrupt enable and turns that interrupt request off; writing 0 does nothing.

values.text: Pipe Error interrupt on: a request is raised when the Pipe Error flag is set.

fields.name: TRFAIL
fields.text: Writing 1 clears the Transfer Fail interrupt enable and turns that interrupt request off; writing 0 does nothing.

values.text: Transfer Fail interrupt on: a request is raised when the Transfer Fail flag is set.

fields.name: TRCPT
fields.text: Writing 1 clears the Transfer Complete bank x interrupt enable and turns that interrupt request off; writing 0 does nothing.

values.text: Transfer Complete bank x interrupt off.
Transfer Complete bank x interrupt on: a request is raised when the Transfer Complete x flag is set.

registers.name: PINTENSET
registers.title: Host Interrupt Pipe Set Register
notes: A 1 written here turns an interrupt on with no read-modify-write; PINTENCLR shows the same state. Cleared by a USB reset or when the endpoint is disabled.

fields.name: STALL
fields.text: Writing 1 turns on the Stall interrupt; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: TXSTP
fields.text: Writing 1 turns on the Transmitted Setup interrupt; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: PERR
fields.text: Writing 1 turns on the Pipe Error interrupt; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: TRFAIL
fields.text: Writing 1 turns on the Transfer Fail interrupt; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: TRCPT
fields.text: Writing 1 turns on the Transfer Complete x interrupt; writing 0 does nothing.

registers.name: ADDR
registers.title: Address of the Data Buffer
notes: Bank 0 at 0x00, bank 1 at 0x10.

fields.name: ADDR
fields.text: Absolute RAM address of the data pointer; bits 1:0 must be 0 so the descriptor is 32-bit aligned.

registers.name: PCKSIZE
registers.title: Packet Size
notes: Bank 0 at 0x04, bank 1 at 0x14.

fields.name: AUTO_ZLP
fields.text: OUT pipes only: when 1 the USB module handles the zero-length-packet handshake itself; when 0 firmware handles it.

fields.name: SIZE
fields.text: Pipe packet size; cleared when a USB reset is sent. Sizes of 128 bytes and up apply to isochronous pipes only.

values.text: 1024 bytes in HS mode, 1023 bytes in FS mode; isochronous only.

fields.name: MULTI_PACKET_SIZE
fields.text: 14-bit count for multi-packet transfers. IN pipe: total number of bytes sent; write it to 0 when setting up a new transfer. OUT pipe: total data size of the whole transfer, a whole multiple of the maximum packet size.

fields.name: BYTE_COUNT
fields.text: Byte count: an OUT pipe holds how many bytes its most recent OUT or SETUP transaction carried; an IN pipe holds how many bytes its next IN transaction should bring.

fields.name: VARIABLE
fields.text: VARIABLE field carried by the extended (LPM) token. For USB 2.0 Link Power Management: VARIABLE[3:0] is bLinkState, [7:4] is BESL, [8] is bRemoteWake, [10:9] are reserved.

fields.name: SUBPID
fields.text: SUBPID field carried by the extended (LPM) token; set to the LPM SubPID type for Link Power Management.

registers.name: STATUS_BK
registers.title: Host Status Bank
notes: Bank 0 at 0x0A, bank 1 at 0x1A.

fields.name: ERRORFLOW
fields.text: Set when an error flow is seen on this bank: a NAK received on an IN or OUT transfer, an overrun on an isochronous IN, or an underflow on an isochronous OUT.

fields.name: CRCERR
fields.text: Set when an isochronous IN bank receives data with a CRC error.

fields.name: PERMAX
fields.text: Errors allowed on this pipe before it freezes itself.

fields.name: PEPNUM
fields.text: Endpoint number this pipe addresses.

fields.name: PDADDR
fields.text: Device address this pipe addresses.

registers.name: STATUS_PIPE
registers.title: Host Status Pipe
notes: Bank 0 at 0x0E, bank 1 at 0x1E.

fields.name: ERCNT
fields.text: Count of errors seen on this pipe.

fields.name: CRC16ER
fields.text: Set when an IN transaction has a CRC16 error.

fields.name: TOUTER
fields.text: Set when a USB transaction times out.

fields.name: PIDER
fields.text: Set when a USB transaction has a PID error.

fields.name: DAPIDER
fields.text: Set when a USB transaction has a data PID error.

fields.name: DTGLER
fields.text: Set when a data toggle error is seen.

fields.name: RUNSTDBY
fields.text: Keeps the ADC running in standby sleep.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.text: Turns the ADC on or off. The written value reads back at once and STATUS.SYNCBUSY stays set until the change has taken effect.

fields.name: SWRST
fields.text: Writing 1 resets every ADC register except DBGCTRL and leaves the ADC disabled; it overrides any other write in the same access. Writing 0 does nothing. CTRLA.SWRST and STATUS.SYNCBUSY clear once the reset is done.

fields.name: REFCOMP
fields.text: Turns on offset compensation in the reference buffer, raising gain-stage accuracy at the cost of lower input impedance and a longer reference start-up.

fields.name: REFSEL
fields.text: Picks the ADC reference. INT1V is the buffered 1.0 V reference taken from the internal 1.1 V bandgap.

values.name: INTVCC1
values.text: VDDANA/2, only when VDDANA is above 2.0 V.

fields.name: ADJRES
fields.text: Division coefficient applied to the accumulated result, in powers of two.

fields.name: SAMPLENUM
fields.text: How many samples are summed into RESULT. CTRLB.RESSEL must be changed if the result gets wider.

fields.name: SAMPLEN
fields.text: Sampling time in half CLK_ADC cycles, which sets the ADC input impedance: sampling time = (SAMPLEN+1) x CLK_ADC/2.

fields.name: PRESCALER
fields.text: ADC clock as a division of the peripheral clock.

fields.name: RESSEL
fields.text: Result resolution of a conversion: 12, 10 or 8 bits.

fields.name: CORREN
fields.text: Digital correction of the result.

values.text: On: RESULT is corrected for gain and offset by GAINCORR and OFFSETCORR, and the conversion takes extra cycles set by OFFSETCORR.

fields.name: FREERUN
fields.text: Free-running mode.

values.text: Free running: each finished conversion starts the next.

fields.name: LEFTADJ
fields.text: Left-adjusts the result in RESULT.

values.text: Left-adjusted: the high byte of a 12-bit result sits in the upper part of RESULT.

fields.name: DIFFMODE
fields.text: Differential mode.

values.text: Differential: the ADC converts the difference between the MUXPOS and MUXNEG inputs.

fields.name: WINMODE
fields.text: Turns on the window monitor and picks its condition.

fields.name: START
fields.text: Writing 1 starts a conversion; hardware clears it once the conversion has begun. Writing 0, or 1 while already set, does nothing.

fields.name: FLUSH
fields.text: Writing 1 flushes the ADC pipeline; writing 0 does nothing. Afterwards the ADC carries on, starting a new conversion if one was pending.

values.text: Flush: the ADC clock restarts on the next peripheral clock edge, conversions in progress are dropped, and the bit clears when done.

fields.name: GAIN
fields.text: Gain of the ADC gain stage: 0x0 1x, 0x1 2x, 0x2 4x, 0x3 8x, 0x4 16x, 0xF 1/2x; 0x5 to 0xE reserved.

fields.name: INPUTOFFSET
fields.text: Offset added to MUXPOS for the positive input during a pin scan (scan on when INPUTSCAN is not 0). The input converted is MUXPOS + INPUTOFFSET; the offset steps up by one after each conversion. At 0 the first conversion uses MUXPOS.

fields.name: INPUTSCAN
fields.text: Pin scan covers INPUTSCAN + 1 inputs, starting at input MUXPOS + INPUTOFFSET; the last input scanned must exist on the device.

fields.name: MUXNEG
fields.text: Picks the negative ADC input.

fields.name: MUXPOS
fields.text: Picks the positive ADC input. Choosing the bandgap needs SAMPCTRL.SAMPLEN written; choosing the DAC output needs the DAC CTRLB.EOEN set.

fields.name: WINMONEO
fields.text: Lets a window monitor match generate an output event.

fields.name: RESRDYEO
fields.text: Lets a finished conversion generate an output event.

values.text: Event when a result is ready.

fields.name: SYNCEI
fields.text: Incoming event flushes the ADC and starts a new conversion.

values.text: Flush and convert on any event.

fields.name: STARTEI
fields.text: Incoming event starts a conversion.

fields.name: SYNCRDY
fields.text: Write 1 to disable the Synchronization Ready interrupt and its request; writing 0 does nothing.

values.text: Enabled: a request follows when INTFLAG.SYNCRDY sets.

fields.name: WINMON
fields.text: Write 1 to disable the Window Monitor interrupt and its request; writing 0 does nothing.

values.text: Enabled: a request follows when INTFLAG.WINMON sets.

fields.name: OVERRUN
fields.text: Write 1 to disable the Overrun interrupt and its request; writing 0 does nothing.

values.text: Enabled: a request follows when INTFLAG.OVERRUN sets.

fields.name: RESRDY
fields.text: Write 1 to disable the Result Ready interrupt and its request; writing 0 does nothing.

values.text: Enabled: a request follows when INTFLAG.RESRDY sets.

fields.name: SYNCRDY
fields.text: Write 1 to enable the Synchronization Ready interrupt; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: WINMON
fields.text: Write 1 to enable the Window Monitor interrupt; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: OVERRUN
fields.text: Write 1 to enable the Overrun interrupt; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: RESRDY
fields.text: Write 1 to enable the Result Ready interrupt; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: SYNCRDY
fields.text: Sets when STATUS.SYNCBUSY falls from 1 to 0, except after an enable or software reset; raises an interrupt if INTENSET.SYNCRDY is 1. Write 1 to clear; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: WINMON
fields.text: Sets one GCLK_ADC cycle after the window monitor condition matches; raises an interrupt if INTENSET.WINMON is 1. Cleared by writing 1 or by reading RESULT; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: OVERRUN
fields.text: Sets when RESULT is overwritten before the CPU read the previous value; raises an interrupt if INTENSET.OVERRUN is 1. Write 1 to clear; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: RESRDY
fields.text: Sets when a conversion result is ready; raises an interrupt if INTENSET.RESRDY is 1. Cleared by writing 1 or by reading RESULT; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: SYNCBUSY
fields.text: 1 while registers are being synchronized between clock domains; 0 once that is finished.

fields.name: RESULT
fields.text: Conversion result, up to 16 bits. A plain 12-bit conversion sits in bits 11:0 when right-adjusted, or with its high byte in 15:8 and low 4 bits in 7:4 when CTRLB.LEFTADJ is set, so an 8-bit reading can take the high byte alone. With averaging the result spans bits 15:0 as set by AVGCTRL.

fields.name: WINLT
fields.text: Lower threshold of the window monitor, used while the window monitor is enabled.

fields.name: WINUT
fields.text: Upper threshold of the window monitor, used while the window monitor is enabled.

fields.name: GAINCORR
fields.text: Gain correction applied to the result when CTRLB.CORREN is 1: a 1-bit integer with an 11-bit fraction, from 0.10000000000 to 1.11111111111 (1/2 up to just under 2).

fields.name: OFFSETCORR
fields.text: Offset correction applied to the result when CTRLB.CORREN is 1, in two's complement.

fields.name: BIAS_CAL
fields.text: Bias calibration; software copies the factory value from the NVM software calibration row here, unaltered, for the ADC to reach its specified accuracy.

fields.name: LINEARITY_CAL
fields.text: Linearity calibration; software copies the factory value from the NVM software calibration row here, unaltered, for the ADC to reach its specified accuracy.

fields.name: DBGRUN
fields.text: Keeps the ADC running while the CPU is halted by a debugger. Change only while the ADC is disabled and no conversion is running.

fields.name: LPMUX
fields.text: Low-power setting of the analog input muxes; not synchronized.

values.text: Low resistance, more power at low supply (e.g. voltage doubler on).
High resistance, less power at low supply (e.g. voltage doubler off).

fields.name: RUNSTDBY
fields.text: Whether the comparators keep running in standby sleep; not synchronized.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.text: Turns the AC on or off. The written value reads back at once; STATUS.SYNCBUSY is set until the change has taken effect.

values.text: AC on; each comparator still needs its own COMPCTRLn.ENABLE.

fields.name: SWRST
fields.text: Writing 1 resets every AC register and leaves the AC disabled; it overrides any other write in the same access. Writing 0 does nothing. CTRLA.SWRST and STATUS.SYNCBUSY clear once the reset is done.

fields.name: STARTx
fields.text: Write 1 to STARTx to run one comparison on COMPx when COMPCTRLx.SINGLE and COMPCTRLx.ENABLE are both 1; otherwise, or for a comparator not fitted, it does nothing. Writing 0 does nothing; always reads 0.

fields.name: COMPEIx
fields.text: Starts a comparison on COMPx on any incoming event. Any connected event triggers the enabled action and the source is not recorded.

fields.name: WINEO0
fields.text: Lets window x generate a peripheral event.

fields.name: COMPEOx
fields.text: Lets the COMPx output generate a peripheral event.

registers.name: INTENCLR
registers.title: Interrupt Enable Clear
notes: Disables interrupts without a read-modify-write; changes show in INTENSET too.

fields.name: WIN0
fields.text: Reads the Window x interrupt enable; write 1 to disable it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: COMPx
fields.text: Reads the Comparator x interrupt enable; write 1 to disable it, writing 0 does nothing.

registers.name: INTENSET
registers.title: Interrupt Enable Set
notes: Enables interrupts without a read-modify-write; changes show in INTENCLR too.

fields.name: WIN0
fields.text: Reads the Window x interrupt enable; write 1 to enable it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: COMPx
fields.text: Reads the Comparator x interrupt enable; write 1 to enable it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: WIN0
fields.text: Sets on the condition chosen by WINCTRL.WINTSELx; raises an interrupt if INTENSET.WINx is 1. Write 1 to clear; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: COMPx
fields.text: Sets on the condition chosen by COMPCTRLx.INTSEL; raises an interrupt if INTENSET.COMPx is 1. Reads 0 for a comparator not fitted. Write 1 to clear; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: WSTATE0
fields.text: Where the signal is relative to window 0, when window 0 mode is on.

fields.name: STATEx
fields.text: Present output level of COMPx; valid only while STATUSB.READYx is 1.

fields.name: SYNCBUSY
fields.text: 1 while registers are being synchronized between clock domains; 0 once that is finished.

fields.name: READYx
fields.text: 1 when the COMPx output is ready, 0 when it is not; reads 0 for a comparator not fitted.

registers.name: STATUSC
registers.title: Status C
notes: Same contents as STATUSA, but reading it starts a comparison on every comparator set for single-shot. The read holds the bus until every enabled comparator has its output ready; a comparator already busy finishes its comparison and no new one starts.

fields.name: WSTATE0
fields.text: Where the signal is relative to window 0, when window 0 mode is on.

fields.name: STATEx
fields.text: Present output level of COMPx; valid only while STATUSB.READYx is 1.

fields.name: WINTSEL0
fields.text: Condition that raises the window 0 interrupt.

fields.name: WEN0
fields.text: Pairs comparators 0 and 1 as a window.

fields.name: FLEN
fields.text: Output filter for comparator n; written only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0, not synchronized.

fields.name: HYST
fields.text: Hysteresis for comparator n, available only in continuous mode (SINGLE = 0); written only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0, not synchronized.

fields.name: OUT
fields.text: What drives the COMPn I/O pin; written only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0, not synchronized.

values.name: SYNC
values.text: Synchronous, filtered output to the pin.

fields.name: SWAP
fields.text: Exchanges the two inputs of COMPn and inverts its output, usable for offset cancellation; written only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0, not synchronized.

values.text: MUXPOS to the positive input, MUXNEG to the negative.
MUXNEG to the positive input, MUXPOS to the negative.

fields.name: MUXPOS
fields.text: Picks the positive input of comparator n; written only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0, not synchronized.

fields.name: MUXNEG
fields.text: Picks the negative input of comparator n; written only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0, not synchronized.

fields.name: INTSEL
fields.text: Condition on which comparator n raises its interrupt or event; written only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0, not synchronized.

fields.name: SPEED
fields.text: Speed and propagation delay of comparator n; written only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0, not synchronized.

fields.name: SINGLE
fields.text: Operating mode of comparator n; written only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0, not synchronized.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.text: Writing 1 turns comparator n on, 0 turns it off. The read value keeps the old state until the change completes, at least two GCLK_AC_DIG cycles later. While 1, the other COMPCTRLn bits are locked until ENABLE is written 0 and that write has synchronized.

fields.name: VALUE
fields.text: Scaling of the VDD scaler for channel n: VSCALE = VDD x (VALUE+1) / 64.

fields.name: RUNSTDBY
fields.text: Run in standby: keeps the DAC output buffer usable in standby sleep. Not synchronized.

values.text: Output buffer may stay on in standby.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.text: Turns the DAC on or off after a synchronization delay. A written value reads back at once and sets SYNCBUSY.ENABLE, which clears when the change is complete.

fields.name: SWRST
fields.text: Software reset: a 1 returns every DAC register to its reset value and disables the DAC; a 0 does nothing. It overrides any other write made in the same access. CTRLA.SWRST and SYNCBUSY.SWRST both clear once the reset has finished synchronizing.

fields.name: REFSEL
fields.text: Picks the DAC's reference voltage. INT1V is a buffered 1.0 V taken from the internal 1.1 V bandgap.

fields.name: BDWP
fields.text: Lifts the write protection on DATABUF.

values.text: DATABUF protected by the Peripheral Access Controller.

fields.name: VPD
fields.text: Voltage pump disable: sets how the voltage pump runs.

values.text: Pump switched on and off automatically.

fields.name: LEFTADJ
fields.text: Sets where the 10 conversion bits sit in DATA and DATABUF.

fields.name: IOEN
fields.text: Internal output enable.

values.text: Internal output on, for use by the AC.

fields.name: EOEN
fields.text: External output enable.

values.text: High-drive buffer drives the DAC output onto the VOUT pin and the ADC positive input mux.

fields.name: EMPTYEO
fields.text: Enables the Data Buffer Empty event, produced when DATABUF is empty.

fields.name: STARTEI
fields.text: Enables the Start Conversion event input.

values.text: Incoming events start nothing; write DATA only, not DATABUF.
Any incoming event starts a conversion; write DATABUF only, not DATA.

fields.name: SYNCRDY
fields.text: Writing 1 turns the Synchronization Ready interrupt off; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: EMPTY
fields.text: Writing 1 turns the Data Buffer Empty interrupt off; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: UNDERRUN
fields.text: Writing 1 turns the Data Buffer Underrun interrupt off; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: SYNCRDY
fields.text: Writing 1 turns the Synchronization Ready interrupt on; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: EMPTY
fields.text: Writing 1 turns the Data Buffer Empty interrupt on; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: UNDERRUN
fields.text: Writing 1 turns the Data Buffer Underrun interrupt on; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: SYNCRDY
fields.text: Writing 1 turns the Synchronization Ready interrupt off; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: EMPTY
fields.text: Data Buffer Empty flag: set when DATABUF moves into DATA and the DAC can take new DATABUF data; raises an interrupt when INTENCLR/SET.EMPTY is 1. A 1 written here, or new data in DATABUF, clears it; a 0 does nothing.

fields.name: UNDERRUN
fields.text: Underrun flag: set when a start-conversion event arrives with DATABUF empty; raises an interrupt when INTENCLR/SET.UNDERRUN is 1. Writing 1 clears it; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: SYNCBUSY
fields.text: Synchronization busy: goes to 1 when a register sync between clock domains begins and back to 0 when it ends.

fields.name: DATA
fields.text: The 10-bit value the DAC turns into a voltage. CTRLB.LEFTADJ places it: 0 puts it in DATA[9:0], 1 in DATA[15:6].

fields.name: DATABUF
fields.text: Data buffer: the value that will be moved into DATA.
